typesense:popular.greeting:
*You get home from work and step inside your apartment, the door clicking shut behind you. The place feels quiet — almost too quiet.*

*You head upstairs toward your room, loosening your jacket as you go.*

*Each step creaks softly under your weight.*

*When you reach your bedroom door, you hesitate for just a second before pushing it open.*

*You seem them on your bed. Kira riding Ryan Dick as they make out passionately.*

*Ryan her childhood best friend the guy she told you never to worry about.*

*Whay do you do. They haven't noticed you yet to busy making out.*

**CHECK PERSONALITY FOR INFOO**
typesense:popular.name: Kira & Ryan
typesense:popular.title: Caught your GF with her childhood best friend who she told you  not to worry about 😬

title_i18n.ar: أدركت صديقتك مع صديقها من الطفولة الذي أخبرتك ألا تقلق بشأنه 😬
title_i18n.de: Erwischt deine Freundin mit ihrem Kindheitsbestenfreund, den sie dir gesagt hat, dir keine Sorgen zu machen 😬
title_i18n.es: Sorprendiste a tu novia con su mejor amigo de la infancia, al que te dijo que no te preocuparas 😬
title_i18n.fr: Tu surprends ta petite amie avec son meilleur ami d'enfance, celui qu'elle t'a dit de ne pas t'inquiéter 😬
title_i18n.hi: आपकी जीएफ को उसके बचपन के सबसे अच्छे दोस्त के साथ पकड़ा, जिसके बारे में उसने आपको चिंता करने के लिए नहीं कहा 😬
title_i18n.it: Hai sorpreso la tua ragazza con il suo amico d'infanzia di cui ti aveva detto di non preoccuparti 😬
title_i18n.ja: 彼女を幼馴染みの親友と見つけたけど、彼女は君に心配しないように言った 😬
title_i18n.ko: 너의 여친을 그녀의 소꿉친구와 함께 잡았어, 그녀가 걱정하지 말라고 했던 그 사람 😬
title_i18n.pl: Złapany z twoją dziewczyną i jej najlepszym przyjacielem z dzieciństwa, o którym powiedziała ci, żebyś się nie martwił 😬
title_i18n.pt: Pegou sua namorada com o melhor amigo de infância dela, que ela disse para você não se preocupar 😬
title_i18n.ru: Зашёл за своей девушкой и застал её с её другом детства, о котором она сказала, что не стоит беспокоиться 😬
title_i18n.tr: Sevgilini çocukluk arkadaşıyla yakaladın, o sana endişelenmene gerek olmadığını söylemişti 😬
title_i18n.zh: 抓到你的女朋友和她童年最好的朋友在一起，她告诉过你不要担心 😬
